text: Fire protection systems by hazard shall be: automatic foam (NFPA 11) and cooling water for the LDO tanks; deluge for oil-filled transformers (NFPA 15); water mist or CO2 (NFPA 12) for the gas turbine enclosure and the lube oil areas; gaseous or water mist for the control room floor voids and the cable rooms; automatic sprinklers or hydrants and hose reels for the buildings as required by the Fire Regulation; portable extinguishers in all buildings; hydrants with a maximum spacing of 60 m.
